notes.title: One year anniversary and upcoming update!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, I can't believe how fast time passed while I've been busy working on the updates.
[b]TCG Card Shop Simulator[/b] has officially been on Steam Early Access for one whole year!

I want to take a quick moment to say a huge [b]THANK YOU[/b] to everyone for your support and being part of my solo dev journey. Your feedback, bug reports, and encouragement have really helped me make the game into something far more polished than it was a year ago!

A quick look back at just how far we’ve come together:

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45081570/506517a539d4ca316bf8cfb27725df30c4a7e4be.jpg[/img]
The journey has been long, but it’s far from over. The biggest feature still on the roadmap is the playable card game. It may be the final boss on the roadmap, but I’ve been actively playtesting with physical prototypes, exploring mechanics, and refining the design. It’s not quite ready yet, and will probably take quite a while until it's up to standard, but I’m just as excited as you are to see it added to the game!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45081570/5aa09d4e8abdb47bf79eeabe9629771ee78fdfc1.jpg[/img]
Next week, there will be an update that comes with some QoL improvements, Steam achievements, bug fixes and a little surprise. Stay tuned!

Again, thank you for being part of this journey. Your support means the world to me, and I’m excited for what’s still to come!

notes.title: Upcoming Update - Card Grading
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45081570/42b393b3f458b06d9690d7a28fbc8cec5af34edc.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hey everyone, it's been quite a while since the last update on TCG Card Shop Simulator. I apologize for the silence and I understand the frustration of not seeing any news on Steam. I want to be clear here and say that I will only make official announcements on Steam when I feel fully confident and ready on new update. That said, rest assured I'm still working solely on this game. [/p][p]The next update will focus on card grading. It's taking longer than expected as there's just a lot of things to adjust and I want to avoid breaking existing features. However, most of the important functions are already in place. notes.title: Upcoming Update - Shop Decoration and Customization
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45081570/262ec0efd9496b1bd35668bc5ed69ad113d473af.jpg[/img]
Hey everyone, the next update will be shop decoration, and I'm working hard alongside other 3D artists to get it finished. This feature is taking quite some time as there really are a lot of decoration assets to create, but rest assured, it will be coming very soon—most likely by the end of March or, at the latest, early April.

In this upcoming update, you'll be able to customize your shop with new floor, wall, and ceiling textures, as well as decorate your shop with items like posters and more. Can't wait to get this update done and see what kind of card shop you will be creating :)

notes.title: Upcoming Update - Shop Expansion and New Items
notes.notes: Hey everyone, I am currently working on new shop expansion and adding new items for the next update. However, the update will only be finished by next month (most likely late January) as I will be taking a break for the rest of December. Been working on the game non stop for way too long, it's time for me to rest and recharge so as not to burnout. Don't worry, I will be back in full swing after the holidays :)

notes.title: Upcoming Update - Customers Trade Cards
notes.notes: Hey everyone, the next update will be taking a longer time as I am adding a new feature on the roadmap, "customers trade cards". I want to make it so that customers will have a chance to sell or trade cards with you at the shop. Hoping to get this done in two weeks time, and a few extra days for testing
